purpose: Create and transactionally publish a bounded project containing exact UTF-8 text and strict-base64 binary files, with byte-digest verification before and after publication.

properties.path: target project directory outside the protected machine body
properties.text_files: object mapping safe project-relative paths to exact UTF-8 text; may be empty when binary_files is non-empty
properties.binary_files: object mapping safe project-relative paths to strict base64 descriptors; may be empty when text_files is non-empty
properties.checks: optional deterministic checks including SHA-256 and bounded media signatures

relationships: extends exact project creation from text-only bodies to bounded mixed byte bodies
uses digest identity for every emitted file and exact UTF-8 equality for supplied text files

anatomy_refs.basis: Publishes one bounded project assembly with transactional replacement and exact file receipts.
Builds an exact mixed-file artifact body, but does not claim compilation or runtime execution.

limitations: binary content must be supplied explicitly as strict base64; this capability does not invent media bytes
declared media types are preserved as caller claims and are not treated as verified
media-signature checks prove only bounded container signatures, not successful decoding, appearance, sound, geometry, or semantics
maximum 256 files, 16 MiB per file, and 64 MiB total in this milestone
generated code is not executed and browser or game behavior still requires host evidence

truth.basis: Every emitted byte is represented by an observed count and SHA-256 receipt; declared media types and bounded signature checks are not inflated into decoding or semantic proof.

agency.basis: The caller supplies every text and binary byte, destination, validation check, publication mode, and replacement choice.

continuity.basis: Publication is staged and reverified, and failed replacement restores the prior project body.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Strict base64, safe paths, byte limits, collision checks, and pre/post-publication verification run before convenience or breadth claims.
